highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 3.116.1 adds 16 KB Android native-library alignment and corrects package path metadata.

bullets.detail: Android native libraries are built with NDK r27c and 16 KB alignment for devices using larger memory pages.
Native asset packaging uses the correct PackagePath attribute rather than the misspelled PackageFile attribute.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp receives the same Android 16 KB alignment and package-path metadata corrections. The 8.3.0.1 package revision is not a native engine upgrade.
